evidence_search.notes: Fresh BankShift and AIID texts inspected. Original Norwegian DNB report retrieved directly and p14 read and visually inspected. The neighbouring 2.7-million-kroner insurance case is separate; report-wide customer-loss figures are not attributed to this attempted executive fraud. No bank ledger or complete investigation accessed.

candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: AI/deepfake executive portrayals lent false authority to a proposed investment transaction and the request for several million Singapore dollars; no transfer was reported.
The purported CEO and CFO appeared to speak and participate in the meeting, while DNB’s leaders denied taking part; that false attribution materially supplied executive authority.
The suspicious WhatsApp invitation triggered the existing employee-to-security reporting procedure before the meeting, and DNB security engaged with the attempt.
The manager’s fraud signal reached DNB security, which identified the attempt and exercised the capacity to direct its observed continuation and cutoff.
Synthetic executive presence and familiar voice in the Teams meeting materially engineered trust in a false payment instruction, while staff lacked the true speakers and purpose.
The fraud-reporting and security-response control became operative before the meeting and DNB ended contact at the payment-instruction stage, containing the attempted transfer.

previous_assessment.no_materialised_harm_basis: DNB identified the attempt before the meeting, observed the call, and ended contact at the payment-instruction stage; the public report says it avoided financial loss. The requested millions are an attempted amount, not a materialised loss. No other separately bandable harm is established.

new_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions were reviewed. Financial S1 uses an express bounded no-loss report and the documented intervention. Other outcomes remain unreported or unresolved. This does not certify zero harm in every dimension or infer safety from absence of complaints.

dimensions.assessment_basis: No injury, illness or medical safety consequence is reported in the attempted executive-payment fraud. There was no direct physical safety test from which zero injury could be certified.
The convincing impersonation and security investigation do not establish distress, suffering or an adverse psychological consequence to an employee or executive.
The payment solicitation does not establish a realised deprivation of liberty, legal entitlement or procedural protection.
No discriminatory selection, adverse comparator or unequal access outcome is reported in the targeted office approaches.

Public executive footage was reused and a voice manipulated. The available sources do not establish compromised private data, unauthorised access to an employee account or a bandable confidentiality consequence.

AIID expressly reports avoided loss. DNB’s originating report confirms pre-meeting fraud identification and deliberate observation; BankShift reports cutoff at payment instructions. Together these support bounded financial S1 with medium confidence. Requested millions are not realised loss. No exact numeric loss or currency conversion is invented.

observed_values.qualitative_value: Registry expressly reports avoided loss; original bank accounts support interruption before a reported transfer. Attempted amount is not a loss.

dimensions.assessment_basis: No damaged recording, corrupted device or destroyed physical or digital asset is reported. Reuse of public footage is not evidence of asset destruction.
The observed meeting and investigation consumed staff attention, but no service outage, material operational disruption or measured recovery burden is reported.

Executive identity was falsely attributed. No distinct consequential humiliation, lost standing or material adverse reliance on an executive’s reputation is established. False attribution alone does not establish a harm band.
The targeted bank fraud does not establish disrupted civic participation or a materialised institutional-information consequence.
No biophysical degradation, affected natural resource or environmental recovery is reported.

The manager reported the suspicious invitation and security directed the observed call and cutoff. This evidences protective action in a payment fraud. It does not establish a companion relationship, tested preservation of relational consent/support or an adverse relational-autonomy consequence.
